hero.headline: Find it. Tune it. Paste it.
hero.body: {count} GSAP components, each with a live preview, settings you can change and code in React, Vue and HTML.

items.title: Find it
items.body: {count} components in {categories} categories, and a new one every week.

items.title: Tune it
items.body: Change the timing, ease and distance in the live preview until it feels right.

items.title: Copy it
items.body: React, Vue or plain HTML. Or let your AI agent pull it through our MCP server.

items.title: Ship it
items.body: It cleans up after itself, respects reduced motion and is safe with server rendering.

code.headline: One component. Every stack.
code.body: Every component comes as plain HTML, React and Vue. In HTML you tune it with data-anm-* attributes; in React and Vue the same settings are props.
code.mcp: Working with an AI agent? Our MCP server hands Claude Code or Cursor the real source, so the GSAP it writes actually runs.

docs.headline: Documented by the people who built it.
docs.body: The docs carry what bit us the first time we shipped each thing: real warnings, real fixes.
